name: protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 11
pathways: positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction
positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: PTPN11 encodes tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 11. Annotated molecular activities include molecular adaptor activity and phosphoprotein phosphatase activity. It participates in positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia; Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia; Neuroblastoma / ganglioneuroblastoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
